examples.chinese: 他是哪國人？
examples.pinyin: Tā shì nǎ guó rén?
examples.english: Which country is he from?

examples.chinese: A：他是哪國人？ B：他是美國人。
examples.pinyin: A: Tā shì nǎ guó rén? B: Tā shì Měiguó rén.
examples.english: A: Which country is he from? B: He is American.

examples.chinese: 她是哪國人？妳知道嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tā shì nǎ guó rén? Nǐ zhīdào ma?
examples.english: Which country is she from? Do you know?

examples.chinese: 請問妳是哪國人？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
examples.english: May I ask where you are from?

examples.chinese: 你喜歡喝哪種茶？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān hē nǎ zhǒng chá?
examples.english: What kind of tea do you like?

examples.chinese: A：你要哪種筆？ B：我要鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào nǎ zhǒng bǐ? B: Wǒ yào qiānbǐ.
examples.english: A: What kind of pen do you want? B: I want a pencil.

examples.chinese: 你想去哪家餐廳？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā cāntīng?
examples.english: Which restaurant do you like to go to?

examples.chinese: 我的錢包在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Where is my wallet?

examples.chinese: 五十塊錢很便宜！妳看，哪個顏色漂亮？
examples.pinyin: Wǔshí kuài qián hěn piányí! Nǐ kàn, nǎ ge yánsè piàoliang?
examples.english: It is inexpensive! Look, which color is better?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想去哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Sounds great! Where do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
examples.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

examples.chinese: 你覺得哪裡不舒服？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
examples.english: Where are you uncomfortable? (What brings you here today?)

examples.chinese: 有哪些動物？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu nǎxiē dòngwù?
examples.english: What animals are there in the book?

items.wordHook: a 口(mouth) calls after 那(that) one, then that one → which one is it: 哪(which)?

examples.chinese: 大家好，我是小林友美。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì Xiǎolín Yǒuměi.
examples.english: Hi, everyone. I am Xiaolin Youmei.

items.wordHook: Once a 大(big) 家(house) held the whole family under one roof — that household became 大家(everyone).

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 弟弟的手很髒，我叫他先把手洗一洗，再吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi de shǒu hěn zāng, wǒ jiào tā xiān bǎ shǒu xǐ yī xǐ, zài chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: My younger brother's hands are very dirty; I asked him to wash his hands first before eating dinner.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"媽媽不在，晚飯我得自己弄。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"弟弟把房間弄得又髒又亂，誰也不想進去。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Māma bù zài, wǎnfàn wǒ děi zìjǐ nòng. Dìdi bǎ fángjiān nòng de yòu zāng yòu luàn, shéi yě bù xiǎng jìnqù.
examples.english: Mom isn't home, so I have to make dinner myself. My little brother made the room both dirty and messy; no one wants to go in.

examples.chinese: 李先生每天晚上六點前一定要吃晚飯，八點後就什麼東西都不吃了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng měitiān wǎnshang liù diǎn qián yīdìng yào chī wǎnfàn, bā diǎn hòu jiù shénme dōngxi dōu bù chī le.
examples.english: Mr. Li must eat dinner before six o'clock every evening; after eight o'clock he doesn't eat anything at all.

examples.chinese: 爸爸下班以後，總是先洗個澡、喝個飲料，再吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Bàba xiàbān yǐhòu, zǒngshì xiān xǐ ge zǎo, hē ge yǐnliào, zài chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After work, Dad always first takes a shower, has a drink, and then eats dinner.

items.wordHook: 晚飯 means dinner: 晚(evening) + 飯(meal) → the evening meal.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共兩萬三千五百零五塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng liǎng wàn sān qiān wǔ bǎi líng wǔ kuài.
examples.english: These stuff cost twenty three thousand, five hundred and five dollars in total.

items.wordHook: a 十(ten) farmer stacks ten bundles of grain into one pile → 千(thousand).

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

items.wordHook: A feathered body takes wing, its 灬(fire) tail feathers flaring like sparks → 鳥(bird).

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我常常在咖啡廳上網、看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài kāfēitīng shàngwǎng, kànshū.
examples.english: I often surf the internet and read at the café.

examples.chinese: 你喜歡山上的風景還是海邊的風景？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shānshàng de fēngjǐng háishì hǎibiān de fēngjǐng?
examples.english: Do you like the scenery on the mountain or on the beach?

examples.chinese: 哥哥喜歡在床上看書。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuān zài chuáng shàng kànshū.
examples.english: My elder brother likes to read in bed.

examples.chinese: 你的筆在那本書上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài nà běn shū shàngmiàn.
examples.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

examples.chinese: 我今天晚上要去同學家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù tóngxué jiā wán.
examples.english: I am going to hang out with my classmate at his/her place tonight.

examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: 燈籠上的小老虎好可愛。
examples.pinyin: Dēnglóng shàng de xiǎo lǎohǔ hǎo kě'ài.
examples.english: The little tiger on the lantern is so lovely.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 很簡單，上網一查就知道了。
examples.pinyin: Hěn jiǎndān, shàngwǎng yì chá jiù zhīdào le.
examples.english: It’s very simple. You can know it as soon as you check it online.

examples.chinese: 好，我上網查查看。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ shàngwǎng cháchá kàn.
examples.english: OK, I will do that.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

examples.chinese: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 我也不知道。我們可以先上網看地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào. Wǒmen kěyǐ xiān shàngwǎng kàn dìtú.
examples.english: I don’t know either. We can check the map online first.

examples.chinese: 啊！上課了！我們先上課吧。
examples.pinyin: A! Shàngkè le! Wǒmen xiān shàngkè ba.
examples.english: Ah! The class has started! Let’s go to class now.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 客廳的桌子上有一個錢包，是不是你的？
examples.pinyin: Kètīng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge qiánbāo, shì bú shì nǐ de?
examples.english: In the living room, there is a wallet on the table. Is that yours?

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

items.wordHook: a ⺊(divination crack) marks the spot 一(one) step up → 上(above).

examples.chinese: 這棟公寓有五層樓，四樓要出租。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng gōngyù yǒu wǔ céng lóu, sì lóu yào chūzū.
examples.english: This apartment building has five floors; the fourth floor is for rent.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
外面的風很大，聲音聽起來很可怕。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn de fēng hěn dà, shēngyīn tīng qǐlái hěn kěpà.
examples.english: The wind outside is very strong; the sound sounds very scary.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"林小姐弄錯了約會的時間，所以遲到了半個小時。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"我覺得「害怕」跟「可怕」的意思差不多，所以常弄錯。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě nòngcuò le yuēhuì de shíjiān, suǒyǐ chídào le bàn ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ juéde “hàipà” gēn “kěpà” de yìsi chàbuduō, suǒyǐ cháng nòngcuò.
examples.english: Miss Lin made a mistake about the appointment time, so she was half an hour late. I think “afraid” and “scary” have similar meanings, so I often misunderstand.

examples.chinese: 從前從前，有一隻很可怕的「動物」，名字叫「年」……
examples.pinyin: Cóngqián cóngqián, yǒu yì zhī hěn kěpà de “dòngwù”, míngzi jiào “Nián”……
examples.english: Once upon a time, there was a very scary 'animal' named 'Nian'...

examples.chinese: 「年」是一隻極可怕、會吃人的怪獸，也就是「年獸」。
examples.pinyin: “Nián” shì yì zhī jí kěpà, huì chī rén de guàishòu, yě jiùshì “niánshòu”.
examples.english: 'Nian' is an extremely scary man-eating monster, also known as the 'Nian monster'.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
昨天晚上的風雨聲好可怕，讓我整個晚上都沒睡好。
我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了
那家商店的廣告牌子被一陣強風吹起後，還差一點打到路上的摩托車，真可怕。
那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的
在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

examples.chinese: 吃太多炸的東西，對身體會有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō zhà de dōngxi, duì shēntǐ huì yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Eating too much fried food will have a bad influence on your health.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
對華人來說，孔子是地位最高、最偉大的老師，他的思想影響了很多人。
父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
